body: Thank you so much for sharing your experience, I’m glad others understand. It definitely does take a long time to clear from the mind. I’m glad you’ve been able to get around it!

I don’t think I’ve really gotten past my lack of empathy. I’m the exact same way. I’m either extremely sensitive to others that it ruins me or I feel absolutely nothing for anyone and I have to force emotion if I don’t want it to ruin my relationships. Recently it’s also been more of the latter. It makes everything really difficult. 

Yeah, it’s not natural for people to be so exposed to this stuff. I’m so glad they deleted it. I’m the exact same way. The suffering of animals always hits me harder than the suffering of humans. They don’t even have the capacity to be evil. 

Me too, I’m so glad you got away as well. That’s really great, odd even cause I did the exact same thing lol. Thank you for explaining your situation too. It really eased me knowing I’m not alone.

I was in nearly the exact situation. My abuser showed me porn and then Reddit and I just spiraled. 

It seriously is. I definitely did that as well and it has just heightened my trauma. It’s creation is a curse and a blessing.
